name: Khazarad, Corner of Gate Wall and Iron Street
desc1: This broad, flagstone-lined street angles sharply in the southwestern
desc2: corner of the dwarven city. The cave wall to the south and west has
desc3: been worn flat, smoothed, and engraved with intricate, angular
desc4: designs. The Gate Wall continues off to the north, while Iron Street
desc5: heads off in an eastern direction.
